course.name: Medicine BMBS
course.campus: Queen's Medical Centre and University Park
course.notes: Five-year, full-time standard-entry course starting in September. The live course page covers 2027 entry, while the detailed admissions policy and selection guidance in the research cover 2026 entry. All cycle-sensitive rules require confirmation against the live Nottingham material for the cycle being advised on.

medical_school.name: School of Medicine
medical_school.cycle_caveat: The official Admissions Policy PDF covers 2026 entry. The live course page covers 2027 entry and contains some updated or inconsistent details.

applicant_pools.name: A100 applicants with GCSE, iGCSE or accepted equivalent results
applicant_pools.notes: Published scoring is GCSE points plus UCAT cognitive points plus SJT points.

applicant_pools.name: A100 applicants without GCSE or accepted equivalent results
applicant_pools.notes: Only UCAT cognitive and SJT points are scored. Nottingham states that these applicants are not disadvantaged.

overall_policy.description: Officially published A100 GCSE, A-level, International Baccalaureate, graduate, international, English-language, age and resit rules are represented. Unsupported or unpublished qualification profiles are blocked from automatic determination.
not_eligible_if: The applicable published academic minimum is not met.
UCAT is not taken in the same year as the UCAS application.
SJT Band 4 is received for interview consideration.
An explicitly excluded A100 qualification is offered as the entry qualification.
manual_review_if: The applicant offers a Scottish, Welsh or Irish qualification profile not officially specified in the supplied research.
The applicant offers an unlisted international qualification or requires equivalence assessment.
The applicant relies on a cycle-sensitive rule not confirmed for the cycle being advised on.

gcse.minimum_requirement: Minimum six GCSEs at grade 7/A, including Biology or Human Biology and Chemistry or Double Science; minimum grade 6/B in Mathematics and English Language.
mandatory_subjects: Biology or Human Biology, or the applicable Double Science result

grade_requirements.requirement_text: Biology or Human Biology and Chemistry or Double Science must be included among the six GCSEs at grade 7/A.

accepted_equivalencies: accepted equivalent qualifications assessed by Nottingham
gcse.sitting_policy: One GCSE resit is permitted only under the published subject and grade conditions.

scoring_model.applies_to: A100 applicants with GCSE, iGCSE or accepted equivalent results
mandatory_components: Biology or Human Biology, or the applicable Double Science result
scoring_model.subject_weighting: All eight scored results are equally weighted. Science subjects receive no multiplier within the GCSE score.

applicants_without_gcse_or_equivalent.selection_basis: UCAT cognitive points plus SJT points only
applicants_without_gcse_or_equivalent.official_caveat: Nottingham states that these applicants are not disadvantaged.

resit_policy.required_resit_grade: The resit must meet the original minimum: grade 6/B for Mathematics or English Language and grade 7/A for the specified sciences.

gcse.notes: GCSE eligibility is assessed before the eight-result GCSE score is calculated.

a_level.third_subject_rule: The third A level must not be one of the published excluded subjects.
a_level.sitting_policy: Three A levels must be passed at the required grades in one sitting.
a_level.science_practical_endorsement: A pass is required where assessed separately; it is not numerically scored.

conditions: A levels were completed within the last 12 months.
At least ABB was achieved at the first sitting.
The first sitting included an A in Biology or Human Biology, or Chemistry.
Resit grades meet AAA and include Biology or Human Biology and Chemistry.

accepted_options.requirement_text: 34 points overall, including Higher Level grade 6 in Biology and Higher Level grade 6 in Chemistry.
Three Higher Level certificates at 6,6,6, including grade 6 in Biology and grade 6 in Chemistry.

accepted_options.minimum_degree_profile: 2:2 honours degree with a taught Master's at merit or above

degree.non_bioscience_requirement: A-level Biology grade B is required where the degree has insufficient biology content.
degree.mathematics_requirement: GCSE Mathematics grade 6/B minimum or equivalent.
degree.degree_completion: The degree must be completed in its natural length and ratified evidence must be supplied by the specified July deadline.
degree.application_restriction: An applicant may apply to A100 or A101, but not both in the same cycle.

scottish_welsh_irish.official_direction: Other qualifications are considered and applicants should contact the University of Nottingham Recruitment and Admissions Team.

access_to_he.related_route_note: A qualifying Access to Medicine Diploma may be accepted for A108 only under its defined credit criteria.

post_16.notes: Only qualification routes with a published A100 profile are represented as automatically determinable.

ucat.calculation: Verbal Reasoning band points multiplied by 2, plus Quantitative Reasoning band points, plus Decision Making band points.
ucat.official_threshold_caveat: Nottingham does not use a fixed score to select for interview. The threshold varies each year and cannot be predicted in advance.

sjt.band_4_policy: Band 4 receives 0 points and automatically excludes the applicant from interview consideration.

gcse.required_resit_grade: Grade 6/B for Mathematics or English Language and grade 7/A for the specified sciences.

conditions: A levels were completed within the last 12 months.
At least ABB was achieved at the first sitting.
The first sitting included an A in Biology or Human Biology, or Chemistry.
Resit grades meet AAA and include Biology or Human Biology and Chemistry.

english_language.notes: The listed alternatives apply where the GCSE English Language requirement is not met.

international.transcript_requirement: Applicants without a full GCSE or iGCSE history must provide a Year 10 or 11 transcript showing approximately six subjects, including Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics and English, at an equivalent standard.

age_or_professional_checks.age_reference_date: 1 September in the year of entry
age_or_professional_checks.under_18_requirement: A parent or legal guardian must complete the University consent form if the applicant is under 18 at registration.
age_or_professional_checks.excluded: Applicants who would be in their 16th year on 1 September are not considered.

score_components.notes: Eight GCSEs are scored using 9/A*=4, 8=3, 7/A=2, 6/B=1 and below 6/B=0.
Band 4 is not merely a zero score; it excludes the applicant from interview consideration.

total_score.selection_action: Top-scoring applicants are invited until interview capacity is filled.
total_score.notes: No fixed or published cut-off exists. The competitive threshold changes with applicant numbers and performance each year.

calculation.notes: The point sum is official. No additional percentage weighting or unpublished formula is represented.

thresholds.notes: Nottingham does not publish a fixed interview cut-off. Historical FOI ranges are stored separately as guidance only.

home_international_pool_separation.notes: Separate Home and International place allocations and statistics must not be converted into an inferred separate-pool rule.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: The official combined formula supports activated guidance-only historical positioning. It does not create a current-cycle threshold or admissions outcome.

contextual_admissions.scope: Eligible UK Home fee-status applicants meeting University of Nottingham contextual criteria.

adjustments.subject_condition: At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.
At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.
At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.

contextual_admissions.non_a_level_equivalents: Contextual treatment of other equivalent qualifications is reviewed case by case.
contextual_admissions.related_route_note: A108 is the dedicated foundation and widening-participation route for eligible applicants who do not meet standard A100 grades.
contextual_admissions.notes: Contextual status does not change the published GCSE and UCAT point formula and adds no ranking points.

ranking_pools.name: A100 published scoring scope
ranking_factors: GCSE points where GCSE or accepted equivalent results are available
ranking_pools.notes: This shared production scope does not assert separate Home and International ranking pools because that separation is not explicitly published in the supplied research.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.

assessed_qualities: Understanding of professional issues such as teamwork
Respect for the contribution of professions allied to medicine
interview_format.assessment_basis: Qualities are based on Medical Schools Council guidance.

delivery_mode.2026_entry: Expected to be entirely online using Microsoft Teams.
delivery_mode.2027_entry_home_page: Likely to be held in person.
delivery_mode.2027_entry_international_page: Refers to Microsoft Teams online delivery.

interview_scoring.notes: The GCSE, UCAT cognitive and SJT shortlisting score has no influence on the interview score or initial offer ranking.

offer_model.ranking_basis: Applicants are ranked solely by total interview score after interview.
offer_model.notes: Offers are made in interview-score order until places are filled.

tie_breakers.applies_when: A100 applicants have identical interview scores
tie_breakers.notes: No more specific UCAT tie-break calculation is inferred.

waiting_list_policy.near_miss_process: Conditional offer-holders who narrowly miss their grade terms may be reviewed in August if places remain unfilled. Decisions are communicated through UCAS.

standard_contextual.subject_condition: At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.

enhanced_contextual.subject_condition: At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.

elite_athletes.subject_condition: At least one A in Biology or Chemistry.

conditions: Meet the grade requirements shown in UCAS Hub.
Satisfactory Disclosure and Barring Service clearance.
Satisfactory check against the Medical Schools Council Excluded Students Database.
offer_selection.notes: The offer process is represented for information and validation. Deterministic offer prediction is unavailable because the numeric interview rubric and future offer threshold are not published.

cycles.publication_format: Ranges across the past few years, not year-by-year figures.
cycles.official_warning: Nottingham advises applicants not to base an application decision on previous-year data because applicant, interview and offer numbers change and may not represent the current competition.

cycles.metric: Combined Nottingham pre-interview points on the 82-point GCSE plus UCAT scale
official_caveats: Nottingham does not publish a fixed interview threshold.
The threshold moves each year with the applicant pool and overall performance.
Historical ranges cannot predict a future threshold in advance.
The ranges are FOI historical guidance and are not a guarantee of interview selection.
Applicants without GCSE or equivalent results are scored on the 50-point UCAT scale, so the 82-point ranges must not be applied to them.

not_published: Historical GCSE averages for successful applicants
Contextual or widening-participation applicant, interview and offer counts
Graduate applicants to A100 as a separate statistical group
A101 applicant, interview and offer ranges
historical_admissions.notes: Official historical admissions ranges and FOI historical interview-score guidance are descriptive only. Neither is a current or future fixed cut-off.

validation.review_notes: The legacy MSC seed was replaced with a research-aligned profile. Required eligibility, scoring, contextual, interview, offer, FOI guidance, source and safeguard fields are implemented. Regression and acceptance checks pass. Eligibility, guidance-only /82 historical positioning, result-card output and metadata visibility are active. No-GCSE /50 applicants and SJT Band 4 applicants remain excluded from banding; deterministic and offer prediction remain disabled.

do_not_infer: Do not infer Scottish, Welsh or Irish A100 qualification profiles.
Do not infer an additional percentage weighting beyond the official 82-point or 50-point sum.
Do not treat FOI historical ranges as fixed, published or current-cycle cut-offs.
Do not apply 82-point historical guidance to applicants scored on the 50-point no-GCSE scale.
Do not infer interview station weights, an offer threshold or a reserve-list ordering method.
Do not infer separate Home and International ranking pools from place allocations or historical statistics.
Do not generalise interview delivery mode across cycles or applicant groups.
Do not convert guidance-only interview-band output into a current-cycle outcome, fixed threshold or admissions rule.
